reason: v1.25 §A. Thirteen example sentences transcribed their own headword with a reading the card does not teach, and exKana is the literal typing target the learner is graded against. Five are proven by byte-identical synthesised audio (instrument 1 of check_dictation_readings), which is proof of the phoneme sequence rather than an inference, and in every one of the five the voice takes the CARD's reading. Seven more were classified as a MEANING difference — the reading changes what the sentence says — independently by Codex and Gemini 3.7 Flash, with the English translation as a third, non-circular witness. One (n1-b039) is a recorded split. Eight further entries were classified REGISTER by both models and are deliberately NOT touched: v1.21 §C decided minority readings are not errors. Two further per-spelling corrections ride along: 箱 read ばこ in 18 standalone positions where the rendaku allomorph cannot occur, and 言う read ゆう, the reading v1.18 retired. The pre-submission review then found the gate itself had a blind spot — it matched a single token, so 240 entries whose headword the tokenizer splits were never inspected and 26 more offenders hid behind it, ten of them N5 counters and dates (四つ typed よんつ, 二日 typed ふたか). The gate is now span-aware and those are corrected here too, plus two further per-spelling sweeps of identical shape (沿い, 得る).

entries.to: たまごをむっつかいました
entries.why: counter: 六つ is むっつ

entries.from: らいげつのよんかはやすみです
entries.to: らいげつのよっかはやすみです
entries.why: date: 四日 is よっか

entries.from: ぼうちゃんはにわでげんきにあそんでいますよ
entries.to: ぼっちゃんはにわでげんきにあそんでいますよ
entries.why: 坊ちゃん is ぼっちゃん. Codex: ぼうちゃん is not a standard reading here; Gemini called it a variant. Split, and it does not need settling: both witnesses agree ぼっちゃん is correct in this sentence, and it is the card's own reading.

entries.from: すいかをほうちょうでまっふたつにわった
entries.to: すいかをほうちょうでまっぷたつにわった
entries.why: 真っ二つ is まっぷたつ. Both witnesses called まっふたつ an accepted variant, and both agree まっぷたつ is correct here.

entries.from: たてもののでいりくちをふさがないでください
entries.to: たてもののでいりぐちをふさがないでください
entries.why: 出入口 is でいりぐち. Codex: the compound rendakus, 口 becomes ぐち; Gemini called でいりくち a variant. Same split, same resolution — でいりぐち is agreed correct by both.

entries.from: なんかあたたかいのみものをのみたい
entries.to: なにかあたたかいのみものをのみたい
entries.why: 何か is なにか; なんか is a spoken contraction both witnesses call colloquial. なにか is natural in this sentence and is what the card teaches.

entries.from: わたくしはいっさくねんにっぽんへきました
entries.to: わたくしはおととしにっぽんへきました
entries.why: 一昨年 is おととし; いっさくねん is the formal on-reading. Both are real, both witnesses agree おととし is correct here, and it is the card's reading.

entries.from: まいつきにとうかにきゅうよがしはらわれます
entries.to: まいつきはつかにきゅうよがしはらわれます
entries.why: 二十日 is はつか — the corpus's only 二十日 card (n5-b147) says so, and にとうか is not a reading of it in any context. Unlike the twenty-six, 二十日 is not this entry's headword, so neither the headword gate nor the per-spelling sweeps reach it; it is corrected because the pre-submission review named it as one of six sentences sitting in the LIVE dictation pool with an exKana that is not a reading of the Japanese — a learner who hears はつか and types it is marked wrong on every keystroke and cannot finish the item. The other five it named are corrected by the twenty-six.
